definitions.short: properly, something weighed out , i.e. (figuratively) a portion of time, i.e. an instance
definitions.full: H4489. moneh [ מֹנֶה ] noun [masculine] counted number, time ; — only מֹנִים עֲשֶׂרֶת ֗֗֗ הֶחֱלִיף Gen 31:7 , 41 changed ten times. .

occurrences.englishText: Your father has deceived me, and changed my wages ten times, but God didn’t allow him to hurt me.
These twenty years I have been in your house. I served you fourteen years for your two daughters, and six years for your flock, and you have changed my wages ten times.
